observations: Photo 0 shows a white rectangular inverter with a black and orange front panel. The brand 'Felicity Solar' is visible at the top, with the text 'PURE SINE WAVE COMBINED INVERTER/CHARGER' below it. The side reads 'SKOMEC FIXED'. There is a small blue LCD screen and several control buttons. A foot in a sandal is visible at the bottom.

Photo 1 shows the rear panel of the same unit. It has a large black fan, red and black terminal blocks labeled 'POS+' and 'NEG-', AC input/output terminals, and a parallel connection port. The unit appears to be mounted on a concrete floor against a wall. The casing shows some wear and minor damage on the right edge.
